# Prerequisites Demo

This runbook demonstrates the `<Prerequisites>` block, which checks that the tools a runbook needs are installed, at the versions it needs.

## 1. Check the tools

Click **Check**. `bash` and `git` are on almost every machine, so the check finds them. Nothing has installed `runbooks-demo-tool` yet, so the check fails, and the block says how to install it. The optional tool is never installed: it only makes the check warn.

<Prerequisites id="tools" description="The tools the rest of this runbook uses.">
```yaml
tools:
  - bash
  - name: git
    version: ">= 2.0"
    install: "[Install Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)"
  - name: runbooks-demo-tool
    description: A stand-in for a tool you'd install. The next block makes it.
    version: ">= 1.0"
    install: Run **Install the demo tool** below, then click **Check again**.
  - name: runbooks-optional-demo-tool
    description: A tool the runbook can do without.
    optional: true
```
</Prerequisites>

## 2. Install the missing tool

This block writes a small `runbooks-demo-tool` script to `bin/` in the working directory, and puts that directory on PATH for the blocks that run after it. Run it, then click **Check again** above: the check finds the tool without a restart.

<Command
    id="install-demo-tool"
    title="Install the demo tool"
    command={`mkdir -p bin
echo '#!/bin/sh' > bin/runbooks-demo-tool
echo 'echo "runbooks-demo-tool 1.2.3"' >> bin/runbooks-demo-tool
chmod +x bin/runbooks-demo-tool
export PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH"`}
    successMessage="Installed. Click **Check again** above."
/>

## 3. Use what the check found

A check that passes, or only warns, publishes each tool's path and the versions it read as outputs. This block waits for them.

<Command
    id="show-tool-paths"
    title="Show where the tools are"
    command='echo "git {{ .outputs.tools.git_version }} is at {{ .outputs.tools.git_path }}, and runbooks-demo-tool is at {{ .outputs.tools.runbooks_demo_tool_path }}."'
/>
